snippet.title: Cult of the Child Eater: Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
_______________________________
Cult of the Child Eater is a multiplayer, cooperative, survival horror game with escape room mechanics & puzzles. The game sets in the haunted corridors of an Eastern European orphanage in the 1980s. A spine-chilling game for 2-6 players where teamwork, strategy and survival instinct are your only chance against the unspeakable horrors. Can you and your team survive the night?💀🪦

*WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170640

KEY FEATURES:
- MULTIPLAYER HORROR: Play with your friends in a heart-pounding journey where teams either get by on their own or cooperate with the other teams. Try to escape the horror, each decision can mean life or death.
- CO-OP & COMPETITIVE GAMEPLAY: While teamwork is essential, your survival may force you to make competitive decisions against other teams.
- DYNAMIC PUZZLES & TRAPS: Each game session is different! Puzzles, traps, and creatures change with every playthrough, ensuring a unique and terrifying experience each time.
- CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT: Develop your characters and uncover secret story elements by playing the game multiple times to improve your survival skills and unravel the dark history of the "Child Eater".
- PHASE-DRIVEN GAMEPLAY: The game unfolds in three escalating phases, each more challenging and terrifying than the last. Can you survive to the end?
- HOSTILE NPCs & MONSTERS: From vigilant caretakers to horrifying monsters born of séances, danger lurks around every corner. The ultimate enemy, the "Child Eater", is the most terrifying of them all—avoiding it may be your only hope.
- ESCAPE ROOM MECHANISMS: Solve complex puzzles alone or with your team to progress. Helping notes provide crucial clues, but time is running out!
- EXPLORABLE AREAS: Traverse the main building, navigate the dangerous wings and uncover the secrets hidden at the back of the orphanage. Will you rush to escape with the boat or risk everything to find out the truth?

🔗 FOLLOW US FOR UPDATES & MORE:

Discord: https://discord.gg/ZvyCjXEm
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/unclegeorgegames/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@unclegeorgegames
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/unclegeorgegames/
Twitter: https://x.com/UncleGeorgGames
Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170640
Website: www.cultofthechildeater.com
Prepare to face your worst fears in "Cult of the Child Eater", the ultimate multiplayer, survival horror experience. Will you and your friends survive the night, or will you become victims of the horrors that lurk in the dark? 💀

*WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170640

*SUBSCRIBE* and hit the notification bell to stay updated on all the latest news and gameplay tips! 🔔
